name: US Sector Residual Mean Reversion After 2020
desc: The textbook stat-arb strategy, Avellaneda-Lee sector-ETF residual reversion, run untuned on US stocks 2016 to 2025: out of sample, after costs and excluding interest on cash, the edge of 2016 to 2020 was gone in 2021 to 2025.

name: Complex vs Simple: A Multi-Signal A-Share Model Against Three Plain Styles
desc: A pre-registered test of a multi-signal A-share stock model against a portfolio built from value, low turnover and low volatility alone, with the same engine and costs, 2018 to 2026.

name: China Index Futures Basis: A Ten-Year Study
desc: What the discount of the IF, IH, IC and IM futures was worth: a rolled long futures position against the total-return index from 2015 to 2026, by contract and by year, with the method and its risks.
